items.t: High-pressure diesel fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure pump, injectors, lines and flush fuel system
items.note: Metal debris usually ruins the whole fuel system. Owners report bills around $7,000 or more.

items.t: Leaking or cracked fuel injectors
items.job: Replace all eight fuel injectors
items.note: Most shops replace all eight. GM covered many LB7 injectors under an extended warranty years ago, which has ended.

items.t: Clogged diesel particulate filter and fuel in the oil
items.job: Clean diesel particulate filter and change oil
items.note: A new filter costs much more. Faulty sensors or injectors causing the clog should be fixed too.

items.t: NOx sensor and DEF system faults
items.job: Replace NOx sensor
items.note: A failed DEF pump, heater or tank costs more. Emissions warranty may cover it.

items.t: Air leaking in at the fuel filter head
items.job: Reseal or replace fuel filter head and re-prime fuel system
items.note: A seal kit is the cheap fix; a complete new filter head costs more.

items.t: Overheating while towing
items.job: Replace fan clutch and clean radiator and intercooler
items.note: A new radiator or water pump adds cost; head gasket damage costs much more.

items.t: Duramax water pump leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Chafed injector wiring harness
items.job: Repair or replace chafed injector wiring harness
items.note: Includes diagnosis. Repairing rubbed spots costs less than a new harness.

items.t: Glow plug tips can break off (recall)
items.job: Reprogram glow plug control module
items.note: Free under GM recall 06522. Glow plugs burned out before the fix may cost extra.

items.t: Rusted brake lines can burst
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines (full preformed line set)
items.note: Fixing one short section costs much less. Rusted fittings can add time.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken bolts, replace manifold bolts and gasket
items.note: Time varies a lot with how many bolts have snapped.

items.t: Clunk felt in the steering wheel
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft
items.note: Lubricating the shaft is cheaper, but the clunk may return.

items.t: Instrument cluster gauges stick or quit
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (replace gauge stepper motors)

items.t: Trailer wiring can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace auxiliary battery trailer harness link (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Heated washer fluid module can overheat (recall)
items.job: Disable and remove heated washer module (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger front air bag inflator can rupture (recalls)
items.job: Replace passenger air bag inflator (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Dual-tank fuel overfill and leak (recalls)
items.job: Replace front tank fuel level sensor or update software (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pivot nut can loosen (recalls)
items.job: Secure brake pedal pivot nut (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Software fault can switch off the front air bags (recalls)
items.job: Reprogram air bag module (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Roof-rail air bag inflator can come apart (recalls)
items.job: Replace roof-rail air bag modules (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear fuel tank can collapse and starve the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace rear fuel tank and pump module (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine block heater cord can short (recall)
items.job: Replace block heater and cord (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Hood can fly open while driving (recall)
items.job: Replace hood latch striker (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt tensioner can set the carpet on fire (recall)
items.job: Install heat shield or carpet fix (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt mountings may not be secured (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and reinstall seat belt anchors (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear wheels can lock up from a transmission valve fault (recall)
items.job: Update transmission software, replace valve body if flagged (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake module bolts can let water in and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pressure modulator (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Power tailgate can open by itself (recall)
items.job: Replace tailgate release switch (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 10-speed automatic valve body failure
items.job: Replace transmission valve body (or transmission)
items.note: Often covered by the powertrain warranty on newer trucks.

items.t: Shifter won't go fully into Park, so the engine won't shut off
items.job: Replace transmission valve body or control module
items.note: Normally covered by the powertrain warranty on trucks this new.

items.t: Steering gear shaft can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering gear (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Gas dual-tank trucks can stall from low fuel transfer (recall)
items.job: Update engine control module software (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 26V-129, by dealer or over the air.

items.t: Owner's manual may be missing (recalls)
items.job: Reset radio and supply owner's manual (recall)
items.note: Free at a GMC dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.
